modules.title: 六个月订单数据怎样变成可比较的趋势
图表帮人更快看见什么

items.title: 编码应贴合比较任务
items.text: 比较类别大小常用柱状图，观察时间变化常用折线图。选择前先问用户要比较什么，而不是先挑一个看起来最炫的图形。

items.title: 读图需要足够语境
items.text: 标题、时间范围、单位、坐标和图例要说明数据在讲什么；重要精确值可提供标签、提示或对应表格，颜色不能是唯一线索。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 图表不是报表的全部，也不能自动说明原因。它把数据关系可视化，仍需数据来源、时间范围和必要文字解释；用户要逐项核对金额或导出时，表格往往更合适。

lessonPractice.title: 需要比较 4 个渠道本月分别带来了多少订单。怎样展示更容易比较？

options.label: 使用柱状图，并标清渠道名称、单位和数值
options.feedback: 对。柱的长度让类别数量容易比较，标签和数值让结果可核对。

options.label: 使用饼图显示四个渠道的占比，只在悬停时查看具体订单数
options.feedback: 饼图能看构成，但相近扇区不容易精确比较；题目要比较四个独立类别的数量，柱长更直接。

options.label: 使用折线图，把四个渠道当成四个连续点连接起来
options.feedback: 四个渠道不是连续时间点，连线会暗示不存在的顺序和趋势，无法准确表达类别比较。

en.title: Operations wants to compare this month's order counts from four channels. Which display fits best?

options.label: Use a bar chart with clear channel names, units, and values to compare the four channels, adding a data table when needed
options.feedback: Correct. Bar length makes category counts easy to compare, while labels and values keep the result checkable.

options.label: Use only a colorful ring with no legend or values and rely on color to feel the difference
options.feedback: People cannot reliably tell what each color means or the precise difference.

options.label: Draw a trend line then state that ads caused orders to grow without other evidence
options.feedback: A chart can show changes happening together; it cannot prove causation on its own.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请把四个渠道本月订单数做成柱状图，明确标题、月份、单位、渠道名和每根柱的数值；不要只靠颜色区分。改完后检查键盘或屏幕阅读器用户能获得同等关键信息，并保留可核对的数据表。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Turn this month's order counts from four channels into a bar chart with a clear title, month, unit, channel names, and a value for each bar; do not rely on color alone. Verify that keyboard or screen-reader users can get the same key information and retain a checkable data table.

learning.assumes: You have seen a bar chart, line chart, or dashboard.
learning.outcome: You can choose a chart for a comparison question and check that its title, axes, legend, values, and alternative explanation make the result understandable.

modules.title: How six months of orders become a comparable trend
What a chart helps people see faster

items.title: Encoding should fit the comparison
items.text: Bar charts commonly compare category sizes; line charts commonly show change over time. Ask what people need to compare before choosing a visually exciting shape.

items.title: Reading a chart needs context
items.text: Title, time range, unit, axes, and legend tell people what data says. Provide labels, tooltips, or a table for important exact values; color cannot be the only cue.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: A chart is not the whole report and cannot automatically explain why something happened. It visualizes data relationships but still needs a source, time range, and necessary explanation. A table is often better for checking each amount or exporting.

distinctions.label: Table
distinctions.text: A {c:chart} uses position, length, or color to reveal trends and differences. A {c:table} preserves exact fields in rows and columns for record-by-record comparison.
